text_before.text: BUGBEARS WERE WAITING ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE GATE.
YOU BOARD A BOAT.
YOU BOARD A BOAT.
DO YOU WANT TO TAKE A BOAT BACK TO PHLAN?
YOU GO UPSTAIRS.
FINALLY YOU ENTER THE CIVILIZED AREA OF PHLAN.
KNOWING THAT TYRANTHRAXUS HAS FINALLY BEEN DEFEATED, YOU LEAVE THE CASTLE. MOVING THROUGH THE STREETS YOU CATCH OCCASIONAL GLIMPSES OF MONSTERS IN HIDING. NONE ATTACK.
YOU RUN FROM THE BATTLE AND OUT THE OUTPOST GATE.  THE YOUNG BOY COULD NOT KEEP UP AND WAS LEFT BEHIND.
THE CAPTAIN SAYS 'YOU HAVE CHOSEN WISELY.'  SOME OF THE BUCCANEERS COME FORWARD AND STRIP YOU OF SOME OF YOUR ITEMS AND MONEY.  THEY ESCORT YOU OUT OF THE COMPOUND.
YOU TRY TO RUN FROM THE GUARDS BUT ARE CUT OFF BY NEW ARRIVALS.  THE YOUNG BOY IS SLOWING YOU DOWN.  IF YOU RUN AGAIN YOU WILL LEAVE HIM BEHIND.
AFTER DEFEATING THE FIRST WAVE OF BUCCANEERS,  YOU SEE ANOTHER WAVE FORMING IN THE DISTANCE.  WITH A LOUD ROAR THEY ATTACK YOU IN FULL FORCE.
YOU HAVE RUN OUTSIDE THE CAPTAINS QUARTERS.  AN ALARM GOES OFF IN THE DISTANCE.  YOU SEE A LARGE GROUP OF ANGRY BUCCANEERS CHARGING TOWARD YOU!
AFTER DEFEATING THE LAST, WAVE YOU SEE ANOTHER WAVE ATTACK FROM THE SOUTH OF THE COMPOUND.
THE LAST OF THE BUCCANNEERS FORM INTO A FINAL WAVE AND ATTACK.
YOU THROW CAUTION TO THE WIND AND ATTACK.  THE CAPTAIN SMILES AND THEN RUSHES TO BATTLE.
AS YOU APPROACH THE CAPTAIN'S QUARTERS THE ELITE GUARDS SOUND AN ALARM AND GUARDS RUSH FORTH AND ATTACK.
YOU KILL THE GUARDS BUT ARE CAUGHT DOING IT.  A LARGE GROUP OF GUARDS RUN TOWARD YOU AND ATTACK.
YOU ENTER THE ENORMOUS CAVE, SEARCH IT AND FIND NOTHING OF INTREST.  YOU THEN LEAVE.
AFTER SPEAKING, THE DRAGON FLYS THROUGH AN OPENNING IN THE CEILING OF THE CAVE.  YOU EXIT THE CAVE TO CONTINUE YOUR QUEST.
'WHEN YOU MEET THE VAMPIRE USE THE BOTTLE AND YOU MAY HAVE A CHANCE IN DEFEATING HIM.  I WISH YOU LUCK.'  AFTER SPEAKING DIOGENES FLIES THROUGH A HOLE IN THE CEILING AND DISSAPPEARS.
AFTER RECOVERING FROM THE FIREBALL YOU SEARCH THE REST OF THE LAIR AND FIND NOTHING OF INTREST.

'I ACCEPT YOUR PLEDGE.  FOR YOUR FIRST DUTY, I COMMAND YOU TO RECOVER A POWERFUL MAGICAL BOTTLE FROM A KOBOLD SETTLEMENT IN THE HILLS FAR TO THE EAST.  THEN RETURN TO ME AND I SHALL GIVE YOU ANOTHER TASK.'
'THAT BOTTLE CONTAINS A POWERFUL EFREET WHO WAS SUMMONED TO KILL VAMPIRES.  HE WILL BE A VALUABLE ALLY IN OLD PHLAN.  IN VALHINGEN GRAVEYARD THERE IS A VAMPIRE.'
YOU TRY TO ATTACK THE DRAGON BUT SEEM TO BE FROZEN IN TIME.  THE DRAGON THROWS A FIREBALL IN THE MIDDLE OF THE PARTY AND THEN DISAPPEARS.  YOU HAVE A STRANGE FEELING THAT YOU JUST MADE A BIG MISTAKE.

'FAR TO THE EAST THERE IS A LARGE KOBOLD COMPLEX.  THERE IS A SILVER BOTTLE OF GREAT POWER THERE THAT WILL HELP YOU ON YOUR QUEST.  RETRIEVE THAT BOTTLE THEN RETURN AND I WILL SEND YOU ON ANOTHER QUEST.'
FAR TO THE EAST THERE IS A LARGE KOBOLD COMMUNITY.  THEY HAVE POSSESION OF A POWERFUL SILVER BOTTLE.  THIS BOTTLE WILL HELP YOU RID THE CITY OF ITS UNDEAD PROBLEM.  GET THE BOTTLE THEN RETURN TO ME.
'THERE YOU SHALL FIND A MAGICAL BOTTLE WHICH WILL HELP YOU IN CLEANSING OLD PHLAN OF ITS EVIL!'
YOU HEAR A GREAT FLAPPING SOUND.  A STRONG WHOOSH OF AIR COMES DOWN UPON THE ADVENTURERS.  A LARGE SILVER DRAGON STANDS BEFORE YOU.  IN A BOOMING VOICE IT SAYS...
AS YOU ENTER THE CAVE YOU ARE GREETED BY DIOGENES, THE SILVER DRAGON.  HE SAYS 'I SEE YOU HAVE RECOVERED THE SILVER BOTTLE FROM THE KOBOLD CAVES.  I CONGRADULATE YOU.'

THE CHARACTERS HEAR A LOUD FLAPPING NOISE AND THEN A WARM RUSH OF AIR HITS THEIR FACES.  STANDING BEFORE YOU NOW IS A GREAT SILVER DRAGON.  HE SAYS, 'YOU ARE WISE TO SEEK MY COUNCIL AND I CAN HELP YOU...'
AFTER HEARING YOUR APOLOGY THE DRAGON SAYS, 'THOUGH YOU ARE FOOLISH I BELIEVE YOUR ACTS ARE NOBLE.  I WILL HELP YOU WITH YOUR QUEST TO CLEANSE THE CITY OF PHLAN FROM EVIL.'
THE DRAGON LANDS, LOOKS THE PARTY OVER THEN SAYS 'YOU HAVE NOTHING THAT INTRESTS ME.  IF YOU WISH TO APEASE ME THEN GO EAST AND DESTROY THE KOBOLD COMMUNITY THERE.'
THE CHARACTERS HEAR A LOUD FLAPPING NOISE AND THEN FEEL A WARM JET OF AIR HIT THEIR FACES.  A HUGE SILVER DRAGON FLIES DOWN TO MEET THEM.
YOU ENTER THE CAVE.
THE RIDERS ESCORT YOU INTO THE OUTPOST.
YOU CLIMB OVER THE WALL AND LEAVE THE OUTPOST.
YOU ESCAPE FROM THE OUTPOST.
YOU SURRENDER.  THEY STRIP YOU OF ALL POSSESSIONS AND TOSS YOU OUT INTO THE WILDERNESS.'
YOU TRY TO RUN BUT ARE CAUGHT.  YOU ARE CAPTURED, STRIPPED AND TOSSED OUT INTO THE WILDERNESS.
YOU RUN FOR YOUR LIVES AS THE GARRISON CHASES BEHIND YOU.  YOU RUN FOR THE FRONT GATE BUT ARE STOPPED BY SOME GUARDS.
'NOW LEAVE. WE HAVE OUR WOUNDED TO LOOK TO.'
'NOW PLEASE LEAVE US TO OUR MOURNING. IT IS A PERSONAL THING FOR OUR PEOPLE.'
THE NOMADS WAIT FOR YOU TO MAKE THE FIRST MOVE.
LOOKING DISAPPOINTED THE HEADMAN SAYS, 'GOOD LUCK IN YOUR TRAVELS.'
THIS DIRECTION WILL TAKE YOU BACK INTO THE WILDERNESS. DO YOU STILL WANT TO GO THIS WAY?
A GROUP OF NOMADS SPOT YOU. THEY SHOUT AND CHARGE. AS THEY COME CLOSER THEIR NUMBERS SWELL WITH ARRIVALS.
YOU CAN SEE CHILDREN PEERING OUT OF THE TENT OPENINGS, ONLY TO BE PUSHED BACK INSIDE BY THEIR MOTHERS.
'THEN YOU MUST LEAVE US,' HE RESPONDS WITH AS MUCH DIGNITY AS HE CAN MUSTER. DO YOU LEAVE?
THERE IS A HOLE IN THE WALL THAT LEADS TO THE OUTSIDE. DO YOU GO THROUGH IT?
THERE IS A HOLE IN THE WALL THAT LEADS TO THE OUTSIDE. DO YOU GO THROUGH IT?
YOU BREAK THROUGH. THE PRIEST TEARFULLY THANKS YOU AND GOES THROUGH THE HOLE.
THERE IS A HOLE IN THE WALL THAT LEADS TO THE OUTSIDE. DO YOU GO THROUGH IT?
YOU BREAK THROUGH. THE PRIEST TEARFULLY THANKS YOU AND GOES THROUGH THE HOLE.
THE PRINCESS SAYS,'I SHALL GO MY OWN WAY NOW, BUT YOU WILL ALWAYS BE REMEMBERED. GOOD HUNTING.'
